startFromZero.title: Start From Zero: 14-Day Grammar & Vocab Foundation
startFromZero.description: Specifically structured for aspirants with regional language schooling or weak English fundamentals.

days.topic: Parts of Speech & Identifying Nouns / Verbs in Sentences
days.tasks: Learn Nouns, Plurals vs Uncountables, 10 Daily Words, 10 Easy Practice Qs
Study 'As well as' vs 'Either/or', 10 S-V Agreement Qs, Flashcards
Study A vs An exceptions, The with superlatives, 10 Article Qs, Root Words: bene/mal
Learn 'abide by', 'adhere to', 'cope with', 15 Preposition Drill Qs

days.topic: Tenses: Definite Past Time vs Present Perfect
days.tasks: Master yesterday/ago rules, Stative verbs prohibitions, 10 Tense Qs
Study Who vs Whom, Reflexive pronoun restrictions, 10 Pronoun Qs

days.topic: Adjectives, Latin Comparatives & Few vs Little
days.tasks: Superior to vs Senior to, Little vs A Little, 15 Modifiers Qs
Hardly... when, No sooner... than, Parallel structure after 'not only'
Master Had + V3 ➔ would have + V3, Subjunctive were, 15 Conditional Qs

days.topic: Non-Finite Verbs: Gerunds after 'To' & Bare Infinitives
days.tasks: 'Look forward to + V-ing', Causative verbs 'make/let', 15 Qs
Solve 20 Error Detection questions with clickable part analysis
Affect vs Effect, Principal vs Principle, 20 Confusing Word Pairs
Solve 20 Single and Double Fillers using tone and grammar filters
Take 25-Question Grammar Diagnostic Mock and record mistakes in My Error Book

thirtyDayPlan.title: 30-Day Comprehensive Bank Exam English Mastery
thirtyDayPlan.description: A high-yield roadmap taking you from zero to 25+ marks in SBI & IBPS Clerk English.

phases.goal: Zero errors in Subject-Verb, Tenses, Prepositions, and Conditionals
150 Editorial Words, 80 Idioms, 50 Phrasal Verbs, Confusing Words
Error Detection Scanner, Word Swap, Fillers, Cloze Test Lab
WPM speed training, Paragraph Mapping, Para Jumbles

phases.focus: Full Exam Simulation & Error Book Review
phases.goal: 5 Full Mocks, Scorecard Analytics, 0 Repeat Mistakes
